diagnosis: The ConnectRPC service implementation for exportDocument handles requests routed from Envoy gRPC-Web. Although the Connect context authenticates the user, the handler directly passes req.documentId into the S3 key path and returns the binary data without checking if req.documentId is owned by user.id or shared with their organization. Any logged-in user can export proprietary files by changing the documentId parameter in the protobuf payload.
